## Problem and result

Explain the problem and what a host, player, operator, or contributor can do after this change.

## Related work

Link the issue. Use `Closes #NUMBER` only when the entire issue is complete.
Link the agreed design discussion for changes to identity, privacy, schema, or session lifecycle.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and what they demonstrate. Include relevant screenshots,
keyboard/browser checks, or API examples. State checks you could not run.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe migrations, configuration changes, privacy/reveal implications, and
operator actions, if any. Do not include secrets or participant data.

Before submitting, target **USAR-FOSS/Quizza:main** and read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
Keep unrelated formatting and local planning/backlog artifacts out of the PR.
